title: olea europaea subsp. sylvestris
intro: Olea europaea subsp. sylvestris, commonly known as wild olive tree, is a subspecies of the olive tree native to the Iberian Peninsula in southwestern Europe. This plant has been used in traditional medicine to promote health and well-being, with reported health benefits including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which may help to protect against chronic diseases such as cardiovascular disease and cancer. The therapeutic actions of wild olive tree include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial actions, which may contribute to its potential in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of Olea europaea subsp. sylvestris include oleuropein, hydroxytyrosol, and tyrosol, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
